name: Toma (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Toma town emblem in white: a five-pointed star bearing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Toma, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1968.

features.role: Toma town emblem — a five-pointed star bearing a ring with a stylised character
